mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a supply shock, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases & UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index by more than 0.5% in a month signals inflationary pressure, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases & UNRATE increases in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 decreases and UNRATE increases in a quarter.
